title: disperis zeylanica var. neilgherrensis
intro: Disperis zeylanica var. neilgherrensis, commonly known as Neilgherries Disperis or Ceylon Disperis, is a species of orchid. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Disperis zeylanica var. neilgherrensis include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
